verses.1:1: Now it came to pass after the death of Moses that the Lord spoke to Joshua the son of Naue, the attendant of Moses, saying,
verses.1:2: "Moses My servant has died. Now therefore, arise and cross over the Jordan, you and all this people, into the land which I am giving to them.
verses.1:3: Every place upon which you step with the sole of your feet, to you I will give it, just as I have spoken to Moses:
verses.1:4: the wilderness and Antilebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates, and as far as the uttermost sea; from the setting of the sun shall be your borders.
verses.1:5: No man shall withstand in your presence all the days of your life; and just as I was with Moses, so I will also be with you, and I will not forsake you nor overlook you.
verses.1:6: Be strong and valiant; for you shall apportion to this people the land which I swore to your fathers to give to them.
verses.1:7: Therefore be strong and valiant, to observe and to do according as Moses My servant commanded you, and you shall not turn aside from them to the right nor to the left, that you may have understanding in all that you do.
verses.1:8: And the book of this law shall not depart from your mouth, and you shall meditate in it day and night, that you may know how to do all the things that are written; then you shall be prospered, and it shall prosper your ways, and then you shall understand.
verses.1:9: Behold, I have commanded you: be strong and valiant; do not be fainthearted nor be afraid, for the Lord your God is with you in all places wherever you may go."
verses.1:10: Then Joshua commanded the scribes of the people, saying,
verses.1:11: "Enter through the midst of the camp of the people, and command the people, saying, 'Prepare provisions for yourselves, for yet three days and you are crossing over this Jordan, entering in to take possession of the land which the Lord, the God of your fathers, is giving to you.'"
verses.1:12: And to Reuben and to Gad and to the half-tribe of Manasseh Joshua said,
verses.1:13: "Remember the word which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, saying, 'The Lord your God has given you rest and has given you this land.'
verses.1:14: Let your wives, your little ones, and your livestock dwell in the land which He has given to you; but you shall cross over girded for battle before your brethren, everyone who is strong, and you shall fight alongside them,
verses.1:15: until the Lord our God gives rest to your brethren even as to you also, and they also inherit the land which the Lord our God is giving to them; and you shall depart, each man to his inheritance, which Moses has given to you beyond the Jordan toward the rising of the sun."
verses.1:16: And answering Joshua, they said, "All things whatever you command us we will do, and to every place wherever you send us we will go.
verses.1:17: According to all things in which we heeded Moses, we will heed you; only may the Lord our God be with you just as He was with Moses.
verses.1:18: And the man who disobeys you, and whoever does not heed your words according as you command him, let him die. Only be strong and valiant."
verses.2:1: And Joshua the son of Naue sent out from Shittim two young men to spy, saying, "Go up and see the land and Jericho." And going forth, the two young men entered into Jericho, and entered into the house of a woman, a harlot, whose name was Rahab, and they lodged there.
verses.2:2: And it was reported to the king of Jericho, saying, "Men of the sons of Israel have come in here to spy out the land."
verses.2:3: And the king of Jericho sent and spoke to Rahab, saying, "Bring out the men who have entered into your house in the night, for they have come to spy out the land."
verses.2:4: And the woman took the two men and hid them, and she spoke to them, saying, "The men did come in to me;
verses.2:5: but as the gate was being shut in the darkness, the men also went out. I do not know where they have gone; pursue after them, if you may overtake them."
verses.2:6: Now she had brought them up onto the roof, and had hidden them in the stalks of flax that were stacked by her upon the roof.
verses.2:7: And the men pursued after them along the road to the Jordan, to the fords, and the gate was shut.
verses.2:8: And it came to pass, when those pursuing after them had gone out, and before they themselves lay down to sleep, she went up onto the roof to them
verses.2:9: and said to them, "I know that the Lord has given you the land, for the terror of you has fallen upon us.
verses.2:10: For we have heard that the Lord God dried up the Red Sea before your face when you came out of the land of Egypt, and all that He did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and Og, whom you utterly destroyed.
verses.2:11: And when we heard, we were dismayed in our heart, and no spirit remained any longer in any of us before your face; for the Lord your God is He who is in heaven above and upon the earth beneath.
verses.2:12: And now, swear to me by the Lord God, since I show mercy to you, show mercy also in the house of my father,
verses.2:13: and preserve alive the house of my father, my mother and my brothers and all my house and all things that belong to them, and you shall deliver my soul from death."
verses.2:14: And the men said to her, "Our life for yours, even to death." And she said, "When the Lord delivers the city to you, you shall show mercy and truth toward me."
verses.2:15: And she let them down through the window.
verses.2:16: And she said to them, "Depart into the hill country, lest those pursuing meet you, and you shall hide yourselves there three days until those pursuing after you return; and after these things you shall depart on your way."
verses.2:17: And the men said to her, "We are guiltless of this oath of yours:
verses.2:18: Behold, we are entering into a part of the city, and you shall set the sign: this scarlet cord you shall tie in the window through which you let us down; and your father, and your mother, and your brothers, and all the house of your father you shall gather to yourself into your house.
verses.2:19: And it shall be that everyone who goes outside the door of your house shall be guilty for himself, and we shall be guiltless of this oath of yours; but as many as are with you in your house, we shall be guilty.
verses.2:20: Yet if anyone wrongs us or even reveals these words of ours, we shall be guiltless of this oath of yours."
verses.2:21: And she said to them, "According to your word let it be." And she sent them away.
verses.2:22: And they went and came into the hill country, and remained there three days; and those pursuing searched out all the roads, and did not find them.
verses.2:23: And the two young men returned and came down from the mountain, and crossed over to Joshua the son of Naue, and recounted to him all the things that had happened to them.
verses.2:24: And they said to Joshua, "The Lord has delivered all the land into our hand, and every inhabitant of that land cowers in dread before us."
verses.3:1: And Joshua rose early in the morning and departed from Shittim; and they came as far as the Jordan, and lodged there before crossing over.
verses.3:2: And it came to pass after three days that the scribes went through the camp,
verses.3:3: and commanded the people, saying, "When you see the ark of the covenant of the Lord our God, and our priests and the Levites bearing it, you shall depart from your places and go after it.
verses.3:4: Yet let there be a distance between us and it; about two thousand cubits away you shall stand. Do not draw near to it, that you may know the way by which you are going; for you have not gone this way since yesterday and the third day before."
verses.3:5: And Joshua said to the people, "Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow, for tomorrow the Lord will do wondrous things among us."
verses.3:6: And Joshua said to the priests, "Take up the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and go before the people." And the priests took up the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and went before the people.
verses.3:7: And the Lord said to Joshua, "In this day I begin to exalt you before all the sons of Israel, that they may know that just as I was with Moses, so I will also be with you.
verses.3:8: And now, command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, saying, 'When you enter into the midst of the water of the Jordan, you shall stand still in the Jordan.'"
verses.3:9: And Joshua said to the sons of Israel, "Draw near here, and hear the word of the Lord our God.
verses.3:10: By this you shall know that a living God is among you, and He will utterly destroy from before our face the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite, and the Jebusite.
verses.3:11: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth is crossing over the Jordan.
verses.3:12: Appoint for yourselves twelve men from the sons of Israel, one from each tribe.
verses.3:13: And it shall come to pass, as soon as the feet of the priests who bear the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth rest in the water of the Jordan, that the water of the Jordan shall fail, and the water coming down shall stand still."
verses.3:14: And the people departed from their tents to cross over the Jordan, and the priests bore the ark of the covenant before the people.
verses.3:15: And as the priests who bore the ark of the covenant entered upon the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord were dipped into a part of the water of the Jordan—now the Jordan was full over all its bank, as in the days of wheat harvest—
verses.3:16: then the waters coming down from above stood still; they stood as one solid mass, standing exceedingly far off, as far as a part of Kathiairein; and that which was going down went down into the sea of Arabah, the Salt Sea, until it completely failed; and the people stood opposite Jericho.
verses.3:17: And the priests who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord stood upon dry ground in the midst of the Jordan; and all the sons of Israel crossed over on dry ground, until all the people had finished crossing over the Jordan.
verses.4:1: And when all the people had finished crossing over the Jordan, the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,
verses.4:2: "Take men from the people, one from each tribe,
verses.4:3: and command them, 'Take up from the midst of the Jordan twelve prepared stones, and carrying these across together with yourselves and with them, set them down in your encampment, wherever you shall lodge there for the night.'"
verses.4:4: And Joshua called twelve distinguished men from the children of Israel, one from each tribe,
verses.4:5: and said to them, "Go forward before me in the presence of the Lord into the midst of the Jordan, and let each one take up a stone from there and lift it upon his shoulders, according to the number of the twelve tribes of Israel,
verses.4:6: that these may be for you a sign set up continually; so that when your son asks you tomorrow, saying, 'What are these stones to us?'
verses.4:7: then you shall declare to your son, saying, 'The Jordan River failed before the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth, when it crossed over it.' And these stones shall be for you a memorial to the children of Israel forever."
verses.4:8: And the children of Israel did so, just as the Lord commanded Joshua; and taking twelve stones from the midst of the Jordan, as the Lord had directed Joshua at the completion of the crossing of the children of Israel, they carried them across with themselves to the camp and laid them down there.
verses.4:9: And Joshua also set up twelve other stones in the Jordan itself, in the place that was beneath the feet of the priests who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and they are there to this present day.
verses.4:10: Now the priests who bore the ark of the covenant stood in the Jordan until Joshua had finished everything that the Lord commanded him to declare to the people; and the people made haste and crossed over.
verses.4:11: And it came to pass, when all the people had finished crossing over, that the ark of the covenant of the Lord crossed over, and the stones before them.
verses.4:12: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half of the tribe of Manasseh crossed over armed before the children of Israel, just as Moses had commanded them.
verses.4:13: Forty thousand men girded for battle crossed over before the Lord to war, toward the city of Jericho.
verses.4:14: On that day the Lord exalted Joshua in the sight of the whole race of Israel, and they feared him just as they had Moses, as long as he lived.
verses.4:15: And the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,
verses.4:16: "Command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant of the testimony of the Lord to come up out of the Jordan."
verses.4:17: And Joshua commanded the priests, saying, "Come up out of the Jordan."
verses.4:18: And it came to pass, when the priests who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord came up out of the Jordan and set their feet upon the ground, that the water of the Jordan rushed back to its place and flowed, as yesterday and the day before, over all its bank.
verses.4:19: And the people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month; and the children of Israel encamped in Gilgal, on the side toward the rising of the sun from Jericho.
verses.4:20: And these twelve stones, which he took out of the Jordan, Joshua set up in Gilgal,
verses.4:21: saying, "When your children ask you, saying, 'What are these stones?'
verses.4:22: declare to your children that on dry ground Israel crossed over this Jordan,
verses.4:23: for the Lord our God dried up the water of the Jordan from before them until they had crossed over, just as the Lord our God did to the Red Sea, which the Lord our God dried up before us until we passed through,
verses.4:24: so that all the nations of the earth may know that the power of the Lord is mighty, and that you may revere the Lord our God in every work."
verses.5:1: And it came to pass, when the kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan and the kings of Phoenicia who were by the sea heard that the Lord God had dried up the Jordan River from before the children of Israel as they were crossing over, their minds melted and they were dismayed, and there was no understanding at all in them because of the presence of the children of Israel.
verses.5:2: Now about this time the Lord said to Joshua, "Make for yourself stone knives from sharp flint rock, and sit down and circumcise the children of Israel."
verses.5:3: And Joshua made sharp stone knives, and circumcised the children of Israel at the place called the Hill of the Foreskins.
verses.5:4: Now this is the manner in which Joshua thoroughly cleansed the children of Israel: as many as were ever born along the way, and as many as were ever uncircumcised of those who had come out of Egypt,
verses.5:5: all these Joshua circumcised; for forty-two years Israel had wandered in the wilderness of Madbaritis;
verses.5:6: therefore most of them were uncircumcised—the fighting men who had come out of the land of Egypt, who disobeyed the commandments of God, concerning whom He also determined that they should not see the land which the Lord swore to our fathers to give, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.5:7: And in their place He raised up their sons, whom Joshua circumcised because they had been born uncircumcised along the way.
verses.5:8: And when they had been circumcised, they kept quiet, remaining right there in the camp until they were healed.
verses.5:9: And the Lord said to Joshua the son of Nun, "On this present day I have taken away the reproach of Egypt from you." And he called the name of that place Gilgal.
verses.5:10: And the children of Israel kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month from evening, on the west of Jericho, beyond the Jordan, in the plain;
verses.5:11: and they ate of the grain of the land, unleavened bread and fresh produce.
verses.5:12: On this day the manna ceased after they had eaten of the grain of the land, and there was no longer manna for the children of Israel; but they harvested the crop of the Phoenicians in that year.
verses.5:13: And it came to pass, when Joshua was at Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and saw a man standing opposite him, and his sword drawn in his hand. And Joshua approached and said to him, "Are you for us, or for our adversaries?"
verses.5:14: And he said to him, "I am chief commander of the host of the Lord; I have now come." And Joshua fell on his face to the earth and said to him, "Master, what do you command your servant?"
verses.5:15: And the chief commander of the Lord said to Joshua, "Loose the sandal from your feet, for the place on which you now stand is holy."
verses.6:1: Now Jericho was shut up and fortified, and no one went out from it nor came in.
verses.6:2: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Behold, I deliver Jericho into your hand, and its king who is in it, who are mighty in strength.
verses.6:3: And you shall station the men of war around it in a circle.
verses.6:5: And it shall come to pass, when you sound the trumpet, let all the people shout aloud together; and when they shout aloud, the walls of the city shall fall down of themselves, and all the people shall rush in, every man straight ahead into the city."
verses.6:6: And Joshua the son of Nun went in to the priests
verses.6:7: and spoke to them, saying, "Command the people to go around and encompass the city, and let the fighting men pass along armed before the Lord;
verses.6:8: and let seven priests having seven sacred trumpets pass along likewise before the Lord and sound vigorously, and let the ark of the covenant of the Lord follow after.
verses.6:9: And let the fighting men march in front, and the priests forming the rear guard behind the ark of the covenant of the Lord, sounding the trumpets."
verses.6:10: Now Joshua commanded the people, saying, "Do not cry out, nor let anyone hear your voice, until the day he himself gives the command to shout aloud; and then you shall shout aloud."
verses.6:11: And when the ark of the covenant of God had gone around, it immediately returned to the camp and lodged there.
verses.6:12: And on the second day Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the covenant of the Lord,
verses.6:13: and the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets went forward before the Lord; and after this the fighting men marched along, and the rest of the multitude behind the ark of the covenant of the Lord;
verses.6:14: and the priests sounded the trumpets, and the entire remaining multitude surrounded the city close by and returned again to the camp. Thus they did for six days.
verses.6:15: And on the seventh day they rose at dawn, and marched around the city six times;
verses.6:16: and on the seventh circuit the priests sounded the trumpets, and Joshua said to the children of Israel, "Shout aloud, for the Lord has delivered the city to you!
verses.6:17: And the city shall be devoted to destruction, it and all things that are in it, to the Lord of hosts. Only spare Rahab the harlot, her and all that is in her house.
verses.6:18: But guard yourselves carefully from what is devoted to destruction, lest, desiring it in your heart, you yourselves take of what is devoted to destruction, and make the camp of the children of Israel a thing devoted to destruction, and utterly destroy us.
verses.6:19: And all silver or gold or bronze or iron shall be holy to the Lord; it shall be brought into the treasury of the Lord."
verses.6:20: And the priests sounded the trumpets; and when the people heard the trumpets, all the people shouted together with a great and mighty war cry. And the entire wall fell down all around, and all the people went up into the city.
verses.6:21: And Joshua devoted it to destruction, and all that was in the city, from man even to woman, from young man even to elder, and even to calf and beast of burden, with the edge of the sword.
verses.6:22: And to the two young men who had spied, Joshua said, "Go into the house of the woman, and bring her out from there, and all that belongs to her."
verses.6:23: And the two young men who had spied out the city went into the house of the woman, and brought out Rahab the harlot, and her father, and her mother, and her brothers, and her kindred, and all that belonged to her; and they placed her outside the camp of Israel.
verses.6:24: And the city was burned with fire, together with all that was in it; only the silver and gold and bronze and iron they gave to be brought into the treasury of the Lord.
verses.6:25: And Rahab the harlot and all her father's household Joshua spared alive, and she dwelt in Israel to this present day, because she hid the spies whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
verses.6:26: And Joshua pronounced an oath on that day before the Lord, saying, "Cursed is the man who shall build that city! With his firstborn he shall lay its foundation, and with his youngest he shall set up its gates." And so did Ozan of Bethel: with Abiron the firstborn he laid its foundation, and with the youngest who survived he set up its gates.
verses.6:27: And the Lord was with Joshua, and his name was throughout all the land.
verses.7:1: Now the children of Israel committed a great trespass and kept back for themselves from the accursed thing; for Achar the son of Carmi, the son of Zambri, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took from the accursed thing; and the Lord burned with wrath against the children of Israel.
verses.7:2: And Joshua sent men to Ai, which is by Bethel, saying, "Spy out Ai."
verses.7:3: So the men went up and spied out Ai, and they returned to Joshua and said to him, "Do not let all the people go up, but let about two thousand or three thousand men go up and take the city by siege; do not lead all the people up there, for they are few."
verses.7:4: So about three thousand men went up, and they fled from before the men of Ai.
verses.7:5: And the men of Ai slew about thirty-six of them, and pursued them from the gate and shattered them down the descent; and the heart of the people was dismayed and became like water.
verses.7:6: Then Joshua tore his garments, and Joshua fell to the earth upon his face before the Lord until evening, he and the elders of Israel, and they cast dust upon their heads.
verses.7:7: And Joshua said, "I pray, O Lord, why did Your servant bring this people across the Jordan, to deliver them to the Amorite to destroy us? If only we had remained and settled by the Jordan!
verses.7:8: And what shall I say, since Israel has turned his back before his enemy?
verses.7:9: For when the Canaanite and all the inhabitants of the land hear of it, they will surround us and blot us out from the earth; and what will You do for Your great name?"
verses.7:10: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Arise! Why have you fallen thus upon your face?
verses.7:11: The people have sinned and have transgressed the covenant which I made with them; having stolen from the accursed thing, they have placed it among their goods.
verses.7:12: The children of Israel shall not be able to stand before their enemies; they shall turn their backs before their enemies, because they have become accursed. I will no longer be with you, unless you remove the accursed thing from among yourselves.
verses.7:13: Arise, sanctify the people, and tell them to sanctify themselves for tomorrow. Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: 'The accursed thing is in your midst; you shall not be able to stand against your enemies until you remove the accursed thing from among you.
verses.7:14: And in the morning you shall all be gathered together by tribes; and it shall be that the tribe which the Lord indicates, you shall bring near by clans; and the clan which the Lord indicates, you shall bring near by household; and the household which the Lord indicates, you shall bring near man by man.
verses.7:15: And whoever is indicated shall be burned with fire, and all that belongs to him, because he has transgressed the covenant of the Lord and has committed a lawless deed in Israel.'"
verses.7:16: So Joshua rose early in the morning and brought the people near by tribes, and the tribe of Judah was indicated.
verses.7:17: And it was brought near by clans, and the clan of the Zerahites was indicated; and it was brought near man by man,
verses.7:18: and Achar the son of Zambri, the son of Zerah, was indicated.
verses.7:19: Then Joshua said to Achar, "Give glory today to the Lord God of Israel, and make confession; declare to me what you have done, and do not hide it from me."
verses.7:20: And Achar answered Joshua and said, "Truly I have sinned before the Lord God of Israel; thus and thus I have done.
verses.7:21: I saw among the spoil a fine embroidered robe, and two hundred didrachmas of silver, and one wedge of gold of fifty didrachmas, and having coveted them, I took them; and behold, they are hidden in my tent, and the silver is hidden beneath them."
verses.7:22: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent in the camp; and these things were hidden in the tent, and the silver was beneath them.
verses.7:23: And they brought them out from the tent and brought them to Joshua and the elders of Israel, and laid them before the Lord.
verses.7:24: Then Joshua took Achar the son of Zerah and brought him up to the Valley of Achor, along with his sons and his daughters, his oxen, his beasts of burden, all his sheep, his tent, and all his possessions, and all the people were with him; and he brought them up to Emek-Achor.
verses.7:25: And Joshua said to Achar, "Why have you brought destruction upon us? May the Lord utterly destroy you, even as today."
verses.7:26: And all Israel stoned him with stones, and they raised over him a great heap of stones; and the Lord ceased from the fierceness of His wrath. Therefore he named it Emek-Achor, to this day.
verses.8:1: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not fear, nor be dismayed; take with you all the men of war, and arise, go up to Ai. Behold, I have delivered into your hands the king of Ai and his land.
verses.8:2: And you shall do to Ai as you did to Jericho and its king, and the spoil of the livestock you shall take as plunder for yourself. Set an ambush for yourself behind the city."
verses.8:3: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up to Ai; and Joshua chose thirty thousand men mighty in strength, and sent them out by night.
verses.8:4: And he commanded them, saying, "Lie in ambush behind the city; do not go far from the city, and you shall all be ready.
verses.8:5: And I and all who are with me will approach the city; and it shall come to pass, when the inhabitants of Ai come out to meet us as previously, that we will flee from before them.
verses.8:6: And when they come out after us, we will draw them away from the city; and they will say, 'These men are fleeing from before us just as at the first.'
verses.8:7: Then you shall rise up from the ambush and march into the city.
verses.8:8: According to this word you shall do; behold, I have commanded you."
verses.8:9: So Joshua sent them out, and they went to the place of ambush and waited between Bethel and Ai, on the west of Ai.
verses.8:10: And Joshua rose early in the morning and mustered the people; and they and the elders went up before the people to Ai.
verses.8:11: And all the people of war who were with him went up, and marching on, they came opposite the city on the east,
verses.8:12: while the ambush of the city was on the west.
verses.8:14: Now it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw it, that he hurried and went out directly to battle to meet them, he and all the people who were with him; and he did not know that an ambush was set against him behind the city.
verses.8:15: And Joshua and Israel saw it and withdrew from before them.
verses.8:16: And they pursued after the children of Israel, and they themselves drew away from the city;
verses.8:17: not one man was left in Ai who did not pursue after Israel; and they left the city open and pursued after Israel.
verses.8:18: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Stretch out your hand with the javelin that is in your hand toward the city, for into your hands I have delivered it; and the ambush shall rise up swiftly from their place." And Joshua stretched out his hand—the javelin—toward the city;
verses.8:19: and the ambush rose up swiftly from their place and came forth as soon as he stretched out his hand, and they came upon the city and captured it; and hurrying, they burned the city with fire.
verses.8:20: And when the inhabitants of Ai looked back behind them, they beheld smoke ascending from the city to heaven; and they no longer had anywhere to flee, this way or that.
verses.8:21: And Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended to heaven; and turning back, they struck down the men of Ai.
verses.8:22: And the others came out from the city to meet them, so that they were in the midst of the camp, some on this side and some on that side; and they struck them down until not one of them was left who survived or escaped.
verses.8:23: But the king of Ai they captured alive, and brought him to Joshua.
verses.8:24: And when the children of Israel had finished slaying all those of Ai who were in the plains and on the mountain at the descent where they had pursued them from it to the very end, Joshua returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.
verses.8:25: And those who fell on that day, from man even to woman, were twelve thousand—all the inhabitants of Ai.
verses.8:27: However, all the spoils that were in the city the children of Israel took as plunder for themselves, according to the command of the Lord, just as the Lord had directed Joshua.
verses.8:28: And Joshua burned the city with fire; he made it an uninhabited mound forever, to this day.
verses.8:29: And the king of Ai he hanged upon a forked tree, and he remained on the tree until evening; and as the sun was setting, Joshua gave orders, and they took down his body from the tree and cast him into the pit, and raised over him a heap of stones, to this day.
verses.9:1: Now when the kings of the Amorites who were across the Jordan heard—those in the hill country, those in the lowland, those along all the coast of the Great Sea, and those toward Anti-Lebanon—and the Hittites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, the Amorites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites,
verses.9:2: they assembled together to wage war against Joshua and Israel, all of them at once. Then Joshua built an altar to the Lord, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal, just as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones upon which iron had not been laid; and there he offered up burnt offerings to the Lord, a sacrifice of deliverance. And Joshua wrote upon the stones the repetition of the law, the law of Moses, before the children of Israel. And all Israel, with their elders and the judges and their scribes, passed alongside on this side and on that side opposite the ark, and the priests and the Levites bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord, both the proselyte and the native-born, half of whom were near Mount Gerizim and half of whom were near Mount Ebal, just as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded to bless the people at the first. And afterward, in this manner, Joshua read all the words of this law, the blessings and the curses, according to all that is written in the law of Moses. There was not a word from all that Moses had commanded Joshua which Joshua did not read in the ears of all the assembly of the children of Israel, to the men and the women and the little children, and to the proselytes who accompanied Israel.
verses.9:3: And the inhabitants of Gibeon heard all that the Lord had done to Jericho and to Ai.
verses.9:4: And they also acted with craftiness, and came and gathered provisions and made themselves ready; and they took old sacks upon their shoulders, and wineskins that were old and torn and bound up;
verses.9:5: and the hollows of their shoes and their sandals were old and patched upon their feet, and their garments were worn old upon them; and the bread of their provisions was dry and moldy and eaten away.
verses.9:6: And they came to Joshua at the camp of Israel at Gilgal, and said to Joshua and Israel, "We have come from a far country; now therefore, make a covenant with us."
verses.9:7: And the children of Israel said to the Horite, "See lest you dwell among me; and how shall I make a covenant with you?"
verses.9:8: And they said to Joshua, "We are your servants." And Joshua said to them, "Where are you from, and from where have you come?"
verses.9:9: And they said, "From a very far country your servants have come, in the name of the Lord your God; for we have heard of His name, and all that He did in Egypt,
verses.9:10: and all that He did to the kings of the Amorites who were across the Jordan—to Sihon king of the Amorites, and to Og king of Bashan, who dwelt in Ashtaroth and in Edrei.
verses.9:11: And when they heard, our elders and all the inhabitants of our land spoke to us, saying, 'Take for yourselves provisions for the way and go out to meet them, and you shall say to them, "We are your servants; now therefore, make a covenant with us."'
verses.9:12: These loaves of bread we packed warm for our journey on the day we set out to come to you, but now they have become dry and eaten away;
verses.9:13: and these wineskins which we filled when new, even these have been torn; and our garments and our shoes have grown old because of the exceedingly long journey."
verses.9:14: Then the rulers took some of their provisions, and did not inquire of the Lord.
verses.9:15: And Joshua made peace with them, and they made a covenant with them to preserve them alive; and the rulers of the congregation swore to them.
verses.9:16: And it came to pass, after three days after making the covenant with them, that they heard that they were near to them and that they dwelt among them.
verses.9:17: And the children of Israel set out and came to their cities; now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeron, and the cities of Jarein.
verses.9:18: And the children of Israel did not fight against them, because all the rulers had sworn to them by the Lord, the God of Israel; and all the congregation murmured against the rulers.
verses.9:19: Then the rulers said to all the congregation, "We have sworn to them by the Lord, the God of Israel; now therefore, we shall not be able to touch them.
verses.9:20: This we will do: we will keep them alive and preserve them, and wrath shall not be against us because of the oath which we swore to them.
verses.9:21: They shall live, and they shall be cutters of wood and bearers of water for all the congregation," just as the rulers said to them.
verses.9:22: Then Joshua called them together and said to them, "Why have you deceived me, saying, 'We are exceedingly far from you,' while you are natives, of those who dwell among us?
verses.9:23: Now therefore, you are accursed; there shall never fail from among you a servant nor a cutter of wood for me and for my God."
verses.9:24: And they answered Joshua, saying, "It was reported to us all that the Lord your God commanded Moses His servant, to give you this land and to destroy us and all who dwell upon it from before you; and we were exceedingly afraid for our lives because of you, and we did this thing.
verses.9:25: And now, behold, we are in your hand; as it pleases you and as it seems good to you, do to us."
verses.9:26: And they did so to them; and Joshua delivered them on that day out of the hands of the children of Israel, and they did not slay them.
verses.9:27: And on that day Joshua appointed them as cutters of wood and bearers of water for all the congregation and for the altar of God; therefore the inhabitants of Gibeon became cutters of wood and bearers of water for the altar of God to this very day, and for the place which the Lord shall choose.
verses.10:1: Now when Adoni-bezek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had taken Ai and had utterly destroyed it—as they had done to Jericho and its king, so they had done to Ai and its king—and that the inhabitants of Gibeon had defected to Joshua and to Israel,
verses.10:2: they were exceedingly afraid of them; for he knew that Gibeon was a great city, like one of the chief cities, and all its men were mighty.
verses.10:3: Therefore Adoni-bezek king of Jerusalem sent to Elam king of Hebron, and to Pheidon king of Jarmuth, and to Jephthah king of Lachish, and to Dabein king of Adullam, saying,
verses.10:4: "Come now, come up to me and help me, and let us wage war against Gibeon; for they have defected to Joshua and to the children of Israel."
verses.10:5: And the five kings of the Jebusites went up—the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Adullam—they and all their people, and they encamped around Gibeon and besieged it.
verses.10:6: And the inhabitants of Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp of Israel at Gilgal, saying, "Do not slacken your hands from your servants; come up to us quickly and deliver us and help us, for all the kings of the Amorites who dwell in the hill country have gathered together against us."
verses.10:7: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and all the people of war with him, every man mighty in strength.
verses.10:8: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not fear them, for into your hands I have delivered them; not one of them shall be left before you."
verses.10:9: And when Joshua came upon them suddenly, he had marched all night from Gilgal.
verses.10:10: And the Lord threw them into panic before the children of Israel, and the Lord crushed them with a great crushing at Gibeon; and they pursued them along the way of the ascent of Horonein, and struck them down as far as Azekah and as far as Makkedah.
verses.10:11: And as they fled from before the children of Israel on the descent of Horonein, the Lord also cast hailstones upon them from heaven as far as Azekah; and there were more who died because of the hailstones than those whom the children of Israel slew with the sword in the battle.
verses.10:12: Then Joshua spoke to the Lord on the day that God delivered the Amorite into the hand of Israel, when He crushed them at Gibeon and they were crushed before the children of Israel; and Joshua said, "Let the sun stand still over against Gibeon, and the moon over against the valley of Aijalon."
verses.10:13: And the sun stood still and the moon remained stationary, until God took vengeance upon their enemies. And the sun stood in the midst of heaven, and did not go forward toward setting until the completion of one day.
verses.10:14: And there was no day like that, neither before nor afterward, that God heeded a man; for the Lord fought alongside Israel.
verses.10:16: And these five kings fled and hid themselves in the cave that is in Makkedah.
verses.10:17: And it was reported to Joshua, saying, "The five kings have been found hidden in the cave that is in Makkedah."
verses.10:18: And Joshua said, "Roll stones against the mouth of the cave, and set men over them to guard them;
verses.10:19: but as for you, do not stand still; keep pursuing after your enemies, and overtake their rear guard, and do not let them enter into their cities, for the Lord our God has delivered them into our hands."
verses.10:20: And it came to pass, when Joshua and every son of Israel had finished striking them with an exceedingly great slaughter to the very end, that those who escaped made their escape into the fortified cities.
verses.10:21: And all the people returned unharmed to Joshua at Makkedah; and not one of the children of Israel muttered with his tongue.
verses.10:22: Then Joshua said, "Open the cave, and bring out these five kings from the cave."
verses.10:23: And they brought out the five kings from the cave: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Adullam.
verses.10:24: And when they had brought them out to Joshua, Joshua called together all Israel and the commanders of the war who had marched with him, saying to them, "Come forward and put your feet upon their necks." And they drew near and put their feet upon their necks.
verses.10:25: And Joshua said to them, "Do not fear them, nor be dismayed; be courageous and be strong, for thus the Lord will do to all your enemies against whom you fight."
verses.10:26: And Joshua slew them and hanged them upon five trees; and they remained hanging upon the trees until evening.
verses.10:27: And it came to pass toward the setting of the sun that Joshua gave command, and they took them down from the trees and cast them into the cave into which they had fled; and they rolled stones against the cave, to this very day.
verses.10:28: And they took Makkedah on that day, and slew it with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed every breathing thing in it; there was not left in it anyone surviving and escaping. And they did to the king of Makkedah as they had done to the king of Jericho.
verses.10:29: Then Joshua and all Israel with him departed from Makkedah to Libnah, and he besieged Libnah.
verses.10:30: And the Lord delivered it into the hands of Israel, and they took it and its king; and he slew it with the edge of the sword, and every breathing thing in it; there was not left in it any surviving and escaping. And they did to its king as they had done to the king of Jericho.
verses.10:31: Then Joshua and all Israel with him departed from Libnah to Lachish, and he encamped against it and besieged it.
verses.10:32: And the Lord delivered Lachish into the hands of Israel, and he took it on the second day; and they slew it with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed it, just as they had done to Libnah.
verses.10:33: Then Elam king of Gaza went up to help Lachish; and Joshua struck him with the edge of the sword, along with his people, until there was not left of them anyone surviving and escaping.
verses.10:34: Then Joshua and all Israel with him departed from Lachish to Adullam, and he encamped against it and besieged it.
verses.10:35: And the Lord delivered it into the hand of Israel, and he took it on that day, and he slew it with the edge of the sword, and every breathing thing in it they slew, just as they had done to Lachish.
verses.10:36: Then Joshua and all Israel with him departed to Hebron, and he encamped against it.
verses.10:37: And he struck it with the edge of the sword, and every breathing thing, all that was in it; there was not one surviving. Just as they had done to Adullam, they utterly destroyed it and all that was in it.
verses.10:38: Then Joshua and all Israel turned back to Debir, and having encamped against it,
verses.10:39: they took it and its king and its villages, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed it and every breathing thing in it, and left in it no one surviving. Just as they had done to Hebron and to its king, so they did to Debir and to its king.
verses.10:40: And Joshua struck all the land of the hill country, and Nabai, and the lowland, and Asedoth, and its kings; they left none of them surviving, and every breathing thing of life he utterly destroyed, just as the Lord, the God of Israel, had commanded,
verses.10:41: from Kadesh Barnea as far as Gaza, all Goshen as far as Gibeon.
verses.10:42: And all their kings and their land Joshua struck at one time, because the Lord, the God of Israel, fought alongside Israel.
verses.11:1: Now when Jabis king of Hazor heard, he sent to Jobab king of Marron, and to the king of Symoon, and to the king of Azeiph,
verses.11:2: and to the kings who were toward Sidon the Great, in the hill country, and in Raba opposite Chinneroth, and in the plain, and in Phenaeddor,
verses.11:3: and to the coastal Canaanites from the east, and to the coastal Amorites, and Hivites, and Jebusites, and Perizzites who were in the mountain, and the Hittites who were below the wilderness toward Maseuman.
verses.11:4: So they went out, they and their kings with them, like the sand of the sea in multitude, with horses and chariots exceedingly many.
verses.11:5: And all these kings assembled and came together to one place, and they encamped at the water of Marron to make war against Israel.
verses.11:6: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid before them, for tomorrow at this hour I will deliver them routed before Israel; you shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire."
verses.11:7: So Joshua and all the people of war came suddenly against them at the water of Marron, and fell upon them in the hill country.
verses.11:8: And the Lord delivered them into the hands of Israel, and striking them down they pursued them as far as Sidon the Great, and as far as Maseron, and as far as the plains of Massoch to the east; and they cut them down until not one survivor was left of them.
verses.11:9: And Joshua did to them just as the Lord had commanded him: he hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.
verses.11:10: And Joshua turned back at that time and captured Hazor and its king; for Hazor had formerly been the ruler of all these kingdoms.
verses.11:11: And they slew every breathing thing in it with the sword and utterly destroyed them all, and no breathing thing was left in it; and they burned Hazor with fire.
verses.11:12: And Joshua took all the cities of the kings and their kings, and slew them with the edge of the sword, and they utterly destroyed them, just as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded.
verses.11:13: Yet Israel did not burn any of the cities built upon mounds; only Hazor alone Israel burned.
verses.11:14: And all its spoil the sons of Israel took as plunder for themselves; but all of them they utterly destroyed with the edge of the sword until he had destroyed them; they did not leave even one breathing thing of them.
verses.11:15: Just as the Lord had commanded Moses His servant, so likewise Moses commanded Joshua, and thus Joshua did; he did not pass over anything of all that Moses had commanded him.
verses.11:16: And Joshua took all the hill country, and all of Adeb, and all the land of Goshen, and the lowland, and the region toward the west, and the mountain of Israel and the low places
verses.11:17: that are beside the mountain, from Mount Achel and that which ascends to Seir, even as far as Baal-gad, and the plains of Lebanon below Mount Hermon; and all their kings he captured, and struck down, and put to death.
verses.11:18: And for many days Joshua waged war against these kings.
verses.11:19: There was not a city that Israel did not take; they took all in war,
verses.11:20: for it came about through the Lord to harden their heart to meet Israel in war, that they might be utterly destroyed, so that mercy might not be given to them, but that they might be utterly destroyed, just as the Lord had spoken to Moses.
verses.11:21: And Joshua came at that time and utterly destroyed the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron, and from Debir, and from Anaboth, and from all the kindred of Israel, and from all the mountain of Judah, together with their cities; and Joshua utterly destroyed them.
verses.11:22: None of the Anakim was left by the sons of Israel; only in Gaza and in Aseldo were they left.
verses.11:23: So Joshua took all the land, just as the Lord had commanded Moses; and Joshua gave them as an inheritance to Israel in apportionment according to their tribes. And the land rested from war.
verses.12:1: Now these are the kings of the land whom the sons of Israel slew, and whose land they possessed as an inheritance beyond the Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the valley of Arnon as far as Mount Hermon, and all the land of Arabah on the east:
verses.12:2: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, ruling from Arnon, which is in the valley along part of the valley, and half of Gilead as far as Jabbok, the borders of the sons of Ammon,
verses.12:3: and Arabah as far as the Sea of Chinnereth on the east, and as far as the Sea of Arabah, the Sea of Salt, on the east, by the way toward Aseimoth, from Thaiman below Medoth Pisgah;
verses.12:4: and Og king of Bashan—he was left of the giants—who dwelt in Ashtaroth and in Edrei,
verses.12:5: ruling from Mount Hermon and from Sekchai, and all Bashan as far as the borders of Gergesei and Machei, and half of Gilead, the borders of Sihon king of Heshbon.
verses.12:6: Moses the servant of the Lord and the sons of Israel struck them down; and Moses gave it as an inheritance to Reuben, and Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
verses.12:7: Now these are the kings of the Amorites whom Joshua and the sons of Israel slew beyond the Jordan toward the sea, at Baal-gad in the plain of Lebanon and as far as Mount Chelcha as one ascends to Seir; and Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel to inherit according to their allotment,
verses.12:8: in the mountain, and in the plain, and in Arabah, and in Asedoth, and in the wilderness, and in Negeb—the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite;
verses.12:9: and the king of Jericho, and the king of Ai, which is near Bethel,
verses.12:10: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron,
verses.12:11: the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish,
verses.12:12: the king of Ailam, the king of Gezer,
verses.12:13: the king of Debir, the king of Asei,
verses.12:14: the king of Hermath, the king of Airath, the king of Arath,
verses.12:15: the king of Libnah, the king of Adullam,
verses.12:17: the king of Ataphout, the king of Hepher,
verses.12:18: the king of Ophek of Arok,
verses.12:20: the king of Symoon, the king of Mamroth, the king of Azeiph,
verses.12:21: the king of Kadesh, the king of Zakach,
verses.12:22: the king of Maredoth, and the king of Jekom of Carmel,
verses.12:23: the king of Eldom of Phenneddor, the king of Geei of Galilee,
verses.12:24: the king of Tirzah: all these kings were twenty-nine.
verses.13:1: Now Joshua was old and advanced in days; and the Lord said to Joshua, "You are advanced in days, and much land remains for an inheritance.
verses.13:2: And this is the land that remains: the territories of the Philistines, the Geshurite, and the Canaanite,
verses.13:3: from the uninhabited region that faces Egypt as far as the borders of Ekron on the left of the Canaanites, it is reckoned to the five satrapies of the Philistines: the Gazite, the Ashdodite, the Ashkelonite, the Gittite, the Ekronite, and the Hivite;
verses.13:4: from Teman, and to all the land of Canaan opposite Gaza, and the Sidonians as far as Taphek, as far as the borders of the Amorites;
verses.13:5: and all the land of Galiath of the Philistines, and all Lebanon toward the rising of the sun, from Galgaa below Mount Hermon as far as the entrance of Hamath;
verses.13:6: everyone who dwells in the hill country from Lebanon as far as Masereth-memphonmaim, all the Sidonians—I Myself will utterly destroy them from before the face of Israel; only distribute it by lot to Israel, just as I commanded you.
verses.13:7: And now divide this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and to the half-tribe of Manasseh,
verses.13:8: from the Jordan as far as the Great Sea toward the setting of the sun you shall give it; the Great Sea shall be the boundary." To the tribes and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to Reuben and to Gad, Moses gave beyond the Jordan; toward the rising of the sun Moses the servant of the Lord gave to them,
verses.13:9: from Aroer, which is on the bank of the brook Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the valley, and all Mishor from Daidaban;
verses.13:10: all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, as far as the borders of the sons of Ammon;
verses.13:11: and Gilead, and the borders of the Geshurite and of the Maachathite, all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan as far as Acha;
verses.13:12: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Edrei and in Ashtaroth; he was left from among the giants, and Moses struck him down and utterly destroyed him.
verses.13:13: Yet the sons of Israel did not utterly destroy the Geshurite and the Maachathite and the Canaanite; and the king of the Geshurite and the Maachathite dwelt among the sons of Israel to this very day.
verses.13:14: Only to the tribe of Levi no inheritance was given; the Lord God of Israel, He is their inheritance, just as the Lord said to them. And this is the apportionment which Moses apportioned to the sons of Israel in Araboth of Moab, beyond the Jordan opposite Jericho.
verses.13:15: And Moses gave to the tribe of Reuben according to their clans.
verses.13:16: And their borders were from Aroer, which is opposite the valley of Arnon, and the city that is in the valley of Arnon, and all Mishor
verses.13:17: as far as Heshbon, and all the cities that are in Mishor, and Dibon, and Baimon-baal, and House of Meelboth,
verses.13:18: and Basan, and Bakedmoth, and Mephaath,
verses.13:19: and Kiriathaim, and Sibmah, and Serada, and Seion on Mount Enab,
verses.13:20: and Beth-peor, and Ashdoth-pisgah, and Beth-thasinoth,
verses.13:21: and all the cities of Mishor, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, whom Moses struck down—him and the leaders of Midian, both Evi and Robok and Zur and Hur and Robe the ruler, spoils of Sihon—and those who dwelt in Sihon.
verses.13:22: Also Balaam the son of Beor, the diviner, they slew in the rout.
verses.13:23: And the borders of Reuben were these: the Jordan was the boundary. This is the inheritance of the sons of Reuben according to their clans, their cities and their villages.
verses.13:24: And Moses gave to the sons of Gad according to their clans.
verses.13:25: And their borders were Jazer, all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the sons of Ammon as far as Araba, which is opposite Arad,
verses.13:26: and from Heshbon as far as Araboth opposite Mizpeh, and Botani and Baan as far as the borders of Dibon,
verses.13:27: and Enadom and Othargaei and Bainthanabra and Succoth and Zaphon, and the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon; and the Jordan shall be the boundary as far as a part of the Sea of Chinnereth, beyond the Jordan on the east.
verses.13:28: This is the inheritance of the sons of Gad according to their clans—they shall turn their neck against their enemies, for it came to be according to their clans—their cities and their villages.
verses.13:29: And Moses gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh according to their clans.
verses.13:30: And their borders were from Maana, and all the kingdom of Bashan, and all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair which are in Bashan, sixty cities;
verses.13:31: and half of Gilead, and in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, for those of Machir, sons of Manasseh, and for half the sons of Machir, sons of Manasseh, according to their clans.
verses.13:32: These are those to whom Moses distributed an inheritance beyond the Jordan in Araboth of Moab, on the other side of the Jordan opposite Jericho to the east.
verses.14:1: And these are those of the sons of Israel who received an inheritance in the land of Canaan, to whom Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the rulers of the fathers' houses of the tribes of the sons of Israel distributed an inheritance.
verses.14:2: By lot they received their inheritance, just as the Lord commanded by the hand of Joshua for the nine tribes and the half-tribe,
verses.14:3: from beyond the Jordan. Yet to the Levites he did not give an allotment among them,
verses.14:4: for the sons of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim; and no portion in the land was given to the Levites, except cities to dwell in and their set-apart lands for the livestock, and their livestock.
verses.14:5: Just as the Lord had commanded Moses, so the sons of Israel did, and they divided the land.
verses.14:6: Then the sons of Judah drew near to Joshua in Gilgal, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, "You know the word which the Lord spoke to Moses, the man of God, concerning me and you in Kadesh Barnea.
verses.14:7: For I was forty years old when Moses the servant of God sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land, and I answered him a word according to his mind.
verses.14:8: Yet my brethren who went up with me turned aside the heart of the people, but I devoted myself to follow the Lord my God.
verses.14:9: And Moses swore on that day, saying, 'The land upon which you stepped shall be an inheritance for you and for your children forever, because you devoted yourself to follow after the Lord our God.'
verses.14:10: And now the Lord has sustained me, just as He said, this forty-fifth year since the Lord spoke this word to Moses, and Israel journeyed in the wilderness. And now, behold, I am eighty-five years old today;
verses.14:11: I am still as strong today as when Moses sent me; in the same way I am strong now to go in and to go out for war.
verses.14:12: And now I ask of you this mountain, just as the Lord said on that day; for you heard this word on that day. Now the Anakim are there—cities strong and great; if therefore the Lord is with me, I shall utterly destroy them, just as the Lord said to me."
verses.14:13: And Joshua blessed him, and gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh, the son of Kenaz, as an inheritance.
verses.14:14: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he followed the command of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.14:15: Now the name of Hebron formerly was the city of Argob; this was the mother city of the Anakim. And the land rested from war.
verses.15:1: And the border of the tribe of Judah according to their families was from the borders of Judea, from the wilderness of Zin as far as Kadesh toward the southwest.
verses.15:2: And their border on the southwest was as far as a part of the Salt Sea, from the ridge that faces toward the southwest;
verses.15:3: and it passes across opposite the ascent of Akrabbim, and goes around Ennak, and goes up on the southwest to Kadesh Barnea, and goes out to Hezron, and goes up to Sarada, and goes out by the way west of Kadesh,
verses.15:4: and goes out to Selmona, and shall extend as far as the Valley of Egypt, and the outlet of its border shall be at the sea; this is their border on the southwest.
verses.15:5: And the border on the east is all the Salt Sea as far as the Jordan. And as for their border on the north, both from the ridge of the sea and from the part of the Jordan,
verses.15:6: the border goes up to Beth-hoglah, and passes along on the north to Beth-arabah, and the border goes up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben;
verses.15:7: and the border goes up to the fourth part of the Valley of Achor, and goes down to Taagad, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim, which is to the southwest of the valley, and it shall extend to the water of the Spring of the Sun, and its outlet shall be the Spring of Rogel;
verses.15:8: and the border goes up into the Valley of Hinnom on the south of Jebus from the southwest—this is Jerusalem—and the border extends to the top of the mountain which is in front of the Valley of Hinnom toward the sea, which is at a part of the land of Rephaim on the north;
verses.15:9: and the border extends from the top of the mountain to the spring of the water of Maphtho, and extends to Mount Ephron, and the border shall lead to Jebaal—this is the city of Jearim;
verses.15:10: and the border shall turn around from Baal toward the sea, and shall pass on to Mount Assar along the slope of the city of Jearim on the north—this is Chesalon—and shall go down to the City of the Sun, and shall pass on toward the southwest;
verses.15:11: and the border shall extend along the slope of Ekron toward the north, and the border shall extend to Succoth, and the border shall pass on toward the southwest, and shall extend to Lemna, and the outlet of the border shall be at the sea.
verses.15:12: And as for their border on the side of the sea, the Great Sea shall mark the boundary. These are the borders of the sons of Judah all around according to their families.
verses.15:13: And to Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a portion in the midst of the sons of Judah by the command of God; and Joshua gave him the city of Arba, the mother city of Anak—this is Hebron.
verses.15:14: And Caleb the son of Jephunneh utterly destroyed from there the three sons of Anak—Sheshai, Talmai, and Ahiman.
verses.15:15: And Caleb went up from there against the inhabitants of Debir; now the name of Debir was formerly City of Letters.
verses.15:16: And Caleb said, "Whoever takes and cuts down the City of Letters and gains mastery over it, I will give him Achsah my daughter as a wife."
verses.15:17: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it; and he gave him Achsah his daughter as a wife.
verses.15:18: And it came to pass, as she was going out, that she took counsel with him, saying, "I will ask my father for a field." And she cried out from the donkey. And Caleb said to her, "What is the matter with you?"
verses.15:19: And she said to him, "Give me a blessing, for you have given me into the land of the Negev; give me Boththanis." And he gave her the upper Gonaithla and the lower Gonaithla.
verses.15:20: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Judah.
verses.15:21: Now their cities were cities belonging to the tribe of the sons of Judah at the borders of Edom in the wilderness: Kaibaiseleel, Ara, and Hazor,
verses.15:25: and the cities of Hezron—this is Hazor—
verses.15:28: and Cholaseola and Beersheba, and their villages and their settlements;
verses.15:32: and Labos, Sale, and Eromoth—twenty-nine cities, and their villages.
verses.15:33: In the lowland: Eshtaol, Raa, and Assa,
verses.15:34: and Ramen, Tano, Ilouthoth, and Maianei,
verses.15:35: and Jarmuth, Adullam, Membra, Socoh, and Azekah,
verses.15:36: and Shaaraim, and Gederah and its settlements—fourteen cities and their villages;
verses.15:41: and Gedor, Bagadiel, Noman, and Makkedah—sixteen cities and their villages;
verses.15:44: and Keilah, Akiezei, Kezib, Bathesar, and Aijalon—ten cities and their villages;
verses.15:45: Ekron, and its villages and their settlements;
verses.15:46: from Ekron to Gemna, and all that are near Ashdod, and their villages;
verses.15:47: Ashdod, and its villages and its settlements; Gaza, and its villages and its settlements, as far as the Brook of Egypt; and the Great Sea marks the boundary.
verses.15:48: And in the hill country: Shamir, Jattir, and Socoh,
verses.15:49: and Renna, and City of Letters—this is Debir—
verses.15:51: and Goshen, Chalu, and Channa—eleven cities and their villages;
verses.15:54: and Huma, and the city of Arba—this is Hebron—and Sorth: nine cities and their settlements;
verses.15:57: and Gibeah and Timnah—nine cities and their villages;
verses.15:59: and Magaroth, Beth-anam, and Thekum—six cities and their villages; Tekoa, and Ephrathah—this is Bethlehem—and Phagor, Aitan, Kulon, Tatam, Eobes, Karem, Galem, Thether, and Manocho—eleven cities and their villages;
verses.15:60: Kiriath-baal—this is the city of Jearim—and Sotheba: two cities and their settlements;
verses.15:62: and Aichioza, and Naphlazon, and the cities of Sodom, and Aknades—seven cities and their villages.
verses.15:63: And the Jebusite dwelt in Jerusalem, and the sons of Judah were not able to destroy them; and the Jebusites dwelt in Jerusalem until that day.
verses.16:1: Now the borders of the sons of Joseph went from the Jordan across from Jericho on the east, and they shall go up from Jericho into the hill country, the wilderness, to Bethel Luz,
verses.16:2: and go out to Bethel, and pass along to the borders of Chatarothi,
verses.16:3: and pass through toward the sea to the borders of Haptalim as far as the borders of Lower Beth Horon, and their outlet shall be at the sea.
verses.16:4: And the sons of Joseph, Ephraim and Manasseh, received their inheritance.
verses.16:5: Now the borders of the sons of Ephraim were according to their families; and the borders of their inheritance on the east were Ashtaroth and Erok as far as Upper Beth Horon and Gazara.
verses.16:6: And the borders shall come toward the sea to Hicasmon on the north of Therma; they shall go around eastward to Thenasa and Sellesa, and pass along from the east to Janoka,
verses.16:7: and to Macho and Ashtaroth, and their villages; and they shall come to Jericho, and extend out to the Jordan.
verses.16:8: And from Taphu the borders shall proceed toward the sea to Chelkana, and their outlet shall be at the sea; this is the inheritance of the tribe of Ephraim according to their families.
verses.16:9: And the cities set apart for the sons of Ephraim were in the midst of the inheritance of the sons of Manasseh, all the cities and their villages.
verses.16:10: And Ephraim did not destroy the Canaanite who dwelt in Gezer; and the Canaanite dwelt in Ephraim to this day, until Pharaoh king of Egypt went up and took it and burned it with fire, and they pierced through the Canaanites and the Perizzites and those who dwelt in Gezer; and Pharaoh gave it as a dowry to his daughter.
verses.17:1: Now the borders of the tribe of the sons of Manasseh fell—for he was the firstborn of Joseph—to Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, for he was a man of war, in the territory of Gilead and in the territory of Bashan.
verses.17:2: And it also came to the rest of the sons of Manasseh according to their families: to the sons of Jezi, and to the sons of Kelez, and to the sons of Jeziel, and to the sons of Shechem, and to the sons of Symarim, and to the sons of Hepher; these were the males according to their families.
verses.17:3: Now Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but only daughters; and these are the names of the daughters of Zelophehad: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.17:4: And they stood before Eleazar the priest and before Joshua and before the rulers, saying, "God commanded by the hand of Moses to give us an inheritance in the midst of our brethren." And by the command of the Lord a lot was given to them among the brethren of their father.
verses.17:5: And their measured portion fell from Anassa, and the plain of Labek out of Gilead, which is beyond the Jordan,
verses.17:6: because the daughters of the sons of Manasseh inherited a lot in the midst of their brethren. And the land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.
verses.17:7: And the borders of the sons of Manasseh were Delanath, which is before the sons of Anath, and they proceed to the borders, to Hiamin and Jassib, to the spring of Thaphthoth;
verses.17:8: it shall belong to Manasseh, and Thapheth on the borders of Manasseh shall belong to the sons of Ephraim.
verses.17:9: And the borders shall go down to the valley of Karana southward by the valley of Jariel—a terebinth tree belonging to Ephraim in the midst of the city of Manasseh; and the borders of Manasseh were on the north to the brook. And its outlet shall be the sea,
verses.17:10: on the south for Ephraim, and on the north for Manasseh; and the sea shall be their borders; and they shall border upon Jaseb on the north, and Issachar on the east.
verses.17:11: And Manasseh shall have in Issachar and in Asher Kaithoan and their villages, and the inhabitants of Dor and its villages, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its villages, and the third part of Mapheta and its villages.
verses.17:12: Yet the sons of Manasseh were not able to utterly destroy these cities; and the Canaanite began to dwell in this land.
verses.17:13: And it came to pass, when the sons of Israel grew strong, that they made the Canaanites subject to them, but they did not utterly destroy them.
verses.17:14: Now the sons of Joseph objected to Joshua, saying, "Why have you given us an inheritance of one lot and one measured portion, whereas I am a numerous people, and God has blessed me?"
verses.17:15: And Joshua said to them, "If you are a numerous people, go up into the forest and clear a place for yourself, if Mount Ephraim is too narrow for you."
verses.17:16: And they said, "Mount Ephraim does not please us; and the Canaanite who dwells in it, in Beth Shan and in its villages, in the valley of Israel, has choice horses and iron."
verses.17:17: And Joshua said to the sons of Joseph, "If you are a numerous people and have great strength, you shall not have one lot;
verses.17:18: for the forest shall be yours, because it is a forest, and you shall clear it, and it shall be yours even when you utterly destroy the Canaanite, though he has choice horses; for you are stronger than he."
verses.18:1: Now the whole congregation of the sons of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and they set up the tabernacle of testimony there, and the land was subdued by them.
verses.18:2: And there remained among the sons of Israel those who had not received their inheritance, seven tribes.
verses.18:3: And Joshua said to the sons of Israel, "How long will you be slack to inherit the land which the Lord our God has given?
verses.18:4: Give from among you three men from each tribe, and let them arise and go through the land, and describe it before me according as it shall be necessary to pass through it." And they came to him,
verses.18:5: and he divided for them seven portions. Judah shall stand as a border for them on the south, and the sons of Joseph shall stand for them on the north.
verses.18:6: "Now you divide the land into seven portions and bring them to me here, and I will draw a lot for you before the Lord our God.
verses.18:7: For there is no portion for the sons of Levi among you, because the priesthood of the Lord is his portion; and Gad and Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan toward the east, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them."
verses.18:8: And the men arose and went. And Joshua commanded the men who were going to survey the land, saying, "Go and survey the land, and come back to me; and here I will draw a lot for you before the Lord in Shiloh."
verses.18:9: And they went and surveyed the land, and saw it, and wrote it down by cities in seven portions in a book, and brought it to Joshua.
verses.18:10: And Joshua cast a lot for them in Shiloh before the Lord.
verses.18:11: And the lot of Benjamin came out first according to their families; and the borders of their lot went out between Judah and the sons of Joseph.
verses.18:12: And their borders on the north were thus: from the Jordan the borders shall go up along the back of Jericho on the north, and go up to the mountain toward the sea, and its outlet shall be Mabdaritis Bethon;
verses.18:13: and from there the borders shall pass through to Luz, along the back of Luz on its south, which is Bethel. And the borders shall go down to Maatarothorech, to the hill country which is to the south of Lower Beth Horon;
verses.18:14: and the borders shall pass through and go along to the mountain that looks toward the sea on the south, from the mountain before Beth Horon southward, and its outlet shall be at Kiriath Baal, which is Kiriath Jearim, a city of the sons of Judah; this is the side toward the sea.
verses.18:15: And the side toward the south is from the part of Kiriath Baal; and the borders shall pass through to Gasin, to the spring of the water of Nephtoah;
verses.18:16: and the borders shall go down to a part—this is before the glen of Sonnam, which is on the side of Emekraphain on the north; and they shall go down to Gaienna on the south of Jebusai southward, and go down to the spring of Rogel;
verses.18:17: and they shall pass through to the spring of Beth Shemesh, and pass along to Galiaoth, which is opposite the ascent of Aithamin, and go down to the stone of Baion of the sons of Reuben;
verses.18:18: and they shall pass through along the back of Beth Arabah on the north, and go down to the borders, to the back of the sea on the north;
verses.18:19: and the outlet of the borders shall be at the bay of the Salt Sea on the north, toward the part of the Jordan on the south; these are the borders on the south.
verses.18:20: And the Jordan shall border it on the east side. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin, its borders all around according to families.
verses.18:21: Now the cities of the sons of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Bethegaio, and Amekasis,
verses.18:22: and Bethabara, and Sara, and Besana,
verses.18:23: and Ain, and Phara, and Jephratha,
verses.18:24: and Karapha, and Kephira, and Moni, and Geba—twelve cities and their villages;
verses.18:26: and Massema, and Miron, and Hamoke,
verses.18:27: and Phira, and Kaphan, and Nakan, and Selekan, and Thareela,
verses.18:28: and Jebus, which is Jerusalem, and cities, and Gabaothjarim—thirteen cities and their villages. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin according to their families.
verses.19:1: And the second lot came forth for the sons of Simeon; and their inheritance was in the midst of the lots of the sons of Judah.
verses.19:2: And their lot was Beersheba, Samaa, and Koladam,
verses.19:6: and Batharoth, and their fields—thirteen cities and their villages;
verses.19:7: Eremmon, Thalcha, Ether, and Ashan—four cities and their villages,
verses.19:8: around their cities as far as Barek, going toward Bameth to the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simeon according to their families.
verses.19:9: Out of the lot of Judah came the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simeon, for the portion of the sons of Judah was greater than theirs; and the sons of Simeon received an inheritance in the midst of their lot.
verses.19:10: And the third lot came forth for Zebulun according to their families. The borders of their inheritance shall be Esedekgola; their borders are
verses.19:11: the sea and Maragelda, and it shall reach to Beth-arabah, into the valley that is before Iekman;
verses.19:12: and it turned back from Seddouk opposite from the east of Beth-shemesh to the borders of Chaselothaith, and it shall pass through to Dabiroth, and it shall go up to Phangai;
verses.19:13: and from there it shall go around opposite toward the east to Gebere, to the city of Katasem, and it shall pass through to Remmona Hamathar Haoza;
verses.19:14: and the borders shall go around to the north to Hamoth, and their outlet shall be at Gaiphael,
verses.19:15: and Katanath, Nabaal, Symoon, Jericho, and Bethman.
verses.19:16: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Zebulun according to their families, cities and their villages.
verses.19:17: And for Issachar the fourth lot came forth.
verses.19:18: And their borders were Iazel, Chasaloth, and Sounan,
verses.19:19: and Hagin, Siona, Reeroth, and Anachereth,
verses.19:21: and Remmas, Ieon, Tomman, Aimarek, and Beersaphes.
verses.19:22: And the borders shall reach to Gaithbor and to Salim toward the sea, and Beth-shemesh; and the outlet of its borders shall be the Jordan.
verses.19:23: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.19:24: And the fifth lot came forth for Asher.
verses.19:25: And their borders were from Heleketh, Haleph, Baithok, and Keaph,
verses.19:26: and Elimelech, Amiel, and Maasa; and it shall reach to Carmel toward the sea, and to Seion and Labanath.
verses.19:27: And it shall turn from the rising of the sun and Baithegeneth, and it shall reach to Zebulun and from Gai and Phthaiel toward the north; and the borders shall enter Saphthaibaithme and Inael, and it shall pass through to Chobamasomel,
verses.19:28: and Elbon, Raab, Ememaon, and Kanthan, as far as great Sidon;
verses.19:29: and the borders shall turn back to Ramah and as far as the spring of Masphassat and of the Tyrians; and the borders shall turn back to Iaseiph, and its outlet shall be the sea, and from Leb and Echozob,
verses.19:31: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Asher according to their families, cities and their villages.
verses.19:32: And for Naphtali the sixth lot came forth.
verses.19:33: And their borders were Moolam, Mola, Besemin, Arme, Nabok, and Iephthamai, as far as Dodam; and its outlets were the Jordan.
verses.19:34: And the borders turn toward the sea to Enath Tabor, and it shall pass through from there to Hiakana; and it shall reach to Zebulun on the south, and it shall reach to Asher toward the sea, and the Jordan from the rising of the sun.
verses.19:35: And the walled cities of the Tyrians: Tyre and Homatha, Daketh and Kenereth,
verses.19:37: and Kedesh, Assarei, and the spring of Hazor,
verses.19:38: and Keroe and Megala, Harim, Baiththame, and Thessamys.
verses.19:39: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali.
verses.19:40: And for Dan the seventh lot came forth.
verses.19:41: And their borders were Sarath and Asa, the cities of Sammaus,
verses.19:46: and from the sea, Ierakon, a border near Joppa.
verses.19:47: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Dan according to their families, their cities and their villages. And the sons of Dan did not drive out the Amorite who oppressed them in the hill country; and the Amorites did not permit them to go down into the valley, and they pressed back from them the border of their portion.
verses.19:48: And the sons of Judah went and fought against Lachish, and took it and struck it with the edge of the sword; and they dwelt in it and called its name Lasenndak. And the Amorite persisted in dwelling in Elom and in Salamin; and the hand of Ephraim grew heavy upon them, and they became tributary to them.
verses.19:49: And they went to take possession of the land according to their border. And the sons of Israel gave a lot to Joshua the son of Nun among them
verses.19:50: by the command of God; and they gave him the city that he asked for, Thamarchares, which is in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city and dwelt in it.
verses.19:51: These are the divisions which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the rulers of the fathers' houses in the tribes of Israel apportioned as an inheritance by lots in Shiloh before the Lord, at the doors of the tabernacle of testimony; and they went to take possession of the land.
verses.20:1: And the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,
verses.20:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'Appoint the cities of refuge of which I spoke to you through Moses,
verses.20:3: a refuge for the manslayer who strikes a person unintentionally; and the cities shall be a refuge for you, and the manslayer shall not die by the avenger of blood until he stands before the congregation for judgment.'"
verses.20:7: And he set apart Kedesh in Galilee, in the hill country of Naphtali, and Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and the city of Arbok, which is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah.
verses.20:8: And beyond the Jordan he gave Bezer in the wilderness, on the plain, from the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead from the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan from the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.20:9: These are the designated cities for the sons of Israel and for the sojourner who dwells among them, that whoever strikes a person unintentionally may flee there, lest he die by the hand of the avenger of blood until he stands before the congregation for judgment.
